*** Add File: {{workspace:task/ethan-park/launch-readiness}}/artifacts/product/launch-readiness.md
+# Hosted Canary Rollout Workflow — launch readiness
+
+**Decision owner:** Ethan Park, Platform & Console  
+**Decision state:** Draft v1 — product and delivery review  
+**Launch date:** Not set  
+
+## Capability and supported scope
+
+The capability is a GA workflow for eligible Hosted API tenants to introduce a new model version or serving configuration on an existing hosted route through deterministic percentage-based canary steps. Customers can create, start, pause, resume, approve, advance, and rollback a rollout; view baseline-versus-canary telemetry and an activity timeline; and rely on policy guardrails, audit events, and SLO-driven auto-stop behavior. [PRD, dsid_63abd3750ce94b12aebc0d25c1f3c45b](/knowledge/company/sources/confluence/product-docs/requirements/hosted-canary-rollout-ga-prd.json)
+
+Supported launch scope is hosted routes for eligible, feature-flagged tenants, with per-region split enforcement after route selection. Dedicated/private parity, automated quality gates, time-based scheduling, multi-armed-bandit optimization, and blanket SIEM export are excluded. Auto-pause is the default protection; auto-rollback remains entitlement/policy dependent. [PRD, dsid_63abd3750ce94b12aebc0d25c1f3c45b](/knowledge/company/sources/confluence/product-docs/requirements/hosted-canary-rollout-ga-prd.json) [GA docs PR, dsid_3a0a0bdfb2ab4a93aecb7dd9b1773e9a](/knowledge/company/sources/github/redwood-docs/pr-922-console-hosted-canary-rollouts-ga-docs.json)
+
+## Satisfied product gates
+
+| Gate | Evidence-backed status |
+|---|---|
+| Defined GA workflow and exclusions | Satisfied: PRD specifies workflow, guardrails, permissions, telemetry, auditability, rollback target, and non-goals. |
+| Customer need | Satisfied: enterprise and regulated customers ask for approvals, audit logs, and change-control evidence. |
+| Beta breadth | Satisfied: six design partners enabled and used rollouts, exceeding the five-partner minimum; four report GA-ready and two conditional. [Tracker, dsid_22985fdc50d14444b0d278a5d93f5e08](/knowledge/company/sources/google_drive/shared_drives/product/console-and-rollouts/beta-design-partners-tracker-hosted-canary.json) |
+| Documentation implementation | Satisfied for code/content readiness: GA concepts, walkthrough, metrics, audit, and troubleshooting docs merged with passing checks. Publication remains coupled to the announcement. [GA docs PR, dsid_3a0a0bdfb2ab4a93aecb7dd9b1773e9a](/knowledge/company/sources/github/redwood-docs/pr-922-console-hosted-canary-rollouts-ga-docs.json) |
+| Safe staged enablement mechanism | Satisfied in design: tenant allowlist, progressive enablement, and kill-switch semantics exist in the delivery plan. [ENG-9180, dsid_2e4653bb8e1b457b934d7309f140d5f3](/knowledge/company/sources/linear/engineering/ENG-9180-feature-flag-and-gradual-enablement-hosted-canary-ui.json) |
+
+## Unresolved delivery items
+
+| Item | Owner | Launch impact |
+|---|---|---|
+| Close ENG-9180 review and verify kill-switch/operator-audit behavior against active rollouts | Dylan Brooks; consult Marcus Lin and Kevin Osei | Blocks broad availability; required before first GA cohort. |
+| Resolve actionable policy-denial messaging and insufficient-volume copy | Jordan Lee / Chloe Martin; design owner Kenji Nakamura | Beta partners repeatedly identified unclear rule/role/action messaging; must be fixed or explicitly accepted for limited launch. [Tracker, dsid_22985fdc50d14444b0d278a5d93f5e08](/knowledge/company/sources/google_drive/shared_drives/product/console-and-rollouts/beta-design-partners-tracker-hosted-canary.json) |
+| Decide and document GA threshold guidance for bursty and long-context traffic | Paula Mendes / Sean Gallagher / Wei Chen | A prior P1 auto-pause sensitivity issue and conditional partner feedback prevent an unconditional GA claim. |
+| Confirm customer notification scope (console-only versus webhook) and document the limitation | Marissa Cole / Elliot Price | Open product decision; not a blocker to a scoped launch if console-only is explicit. [PM-1859, dsid_5444ca17e9664747930ead86571d4804](/knowledge/company/sources/linear/product-management/PM-1859-ga-launch-criteria-and-beta-exit-checklist-hosted-canary.json) |
+
+## Preliminary recommendation
+
+**Conditional-go for a controlled allowlisted launch only.** Product definition, beta breadth, documentation implementation, and staged-enablement design support proceeding toward a limited cohort. Broad GA is not yet reviewable until operational, security, release, and support evidence is incorporated and their required approvals are explicit.
+
+## Revision history
+
+| Revision | Evidence incorporated | Decision |
+|---|---|---|
+| v1 | Product PRD, beta tracker, engineering enablement plan, merged GA docs | Conditional-go for controlled allowlist; broad GA pending cross-functional evidence |
+
+## Source register
+
+- PRD — `dsid_63abd3750ce94b12aebc0d25c1f3c45b`
+- GA criteria — `dsid_5444ca17e9664747930ead86571d4804`
+- Enablement plan — `dsid_2e4653bb8e1b457b934d7309f140d5f3`
+- Design-partner tracker — `dsid_22985fdc50d14444b0d278a5d93f5e08`
+- GA documentation PR — `dsid_3a0a0bdfb2ab4a93aecb7dd9b1773e9a`
*** End Patch

+**Decision state:** Draft v2 — cross-functional readiness review  
@@
 ## Preliminary recommendation
 
 **Conditional-go for a controlled allowlisted launch only.** Product definition, beta breadth, documentation implementation, and staged-enablement design support proceeding toward a limited cohort. Broad GA is not yet reviewable until operational, security, release, and support evidence is incorporated and their required approvals are explicit.
+
+## Operational gates and current evidence
+
+| Gate | State | Evidence / acceptance condition | Owner |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| Cohort metrics and actionable alerting | Conditional | SRE specification is published, but PM-1859 still requires SRE confirmation that alerts are actionable and do not create sustained alert storms. [SRE spec, dsid_5267cd82c772437fa0f9dd9e9568388b](/knowledge/company/sources/confluence/eng-sre/slo-and-error-budgets/hosted-rollouts-slo-metrics-and-alerts.json) [PM-1859, dsid_5444ca17e9664747930ead86571d4804](/knowledge/company/sources/linear/product-management/PM-1859-ga-launch-criteria-and-beta-exit-checklist-hosted-canary.json) | Sean Gallagher / Rafael Mendes |
+| Final default thresholds | Blocked | Release checklist leaves 5xx, timeout, p95, minimum-sample/window, and soak values blank pending product decision and SRE signoff. [Release checklist, dsid_fa0fb79e2f54457093ad3f831e7ac6a2](/knowledge/company/sources/google_drive/shared_drives/engineering/release-engineering/hosted-canary-ga-change-management-checklist.json) | Paula Mendes / Sean Gallagher |
+| Staging game day | Blocked | Required stop/rollback, bad-split, audit, and failure-mode validation is not evidenced as complete. PM-1859 lists the game day as an open sub-issue. | Rafael Mendes / release engineering |
+| Rollback and kill switch | Conditional | Product target is global 0% canary enforcement in under two minutes; staged enablement and kill-switch semantics are defined, but the release checklist must record successful validation. [PRD, dsid_63abd3750ce94b12aebc0d25c1f3c45b](/knowledge/company/sources/confluence/product-docs/requirements/hosted-canary-rollout-ga-prd.json) [ENG-9180, dsid_2e4653bb8e1b457b934d7309f140d5f3](/knowledge/company/sources/linear/engineering/ENG-9180-feature-flag-and-gradual-enablement-hosted-canary-ui.json) | Dylan Brooks / Ethan Park / Mina Haddad; SRE approval |
+| Audit/RBAC | Conditional | Audit-event specification is published and rollout-approver permissions landed; remaining acceptance is end-to-end completeness, actor attribution, retention/export posture, and security signoff. [Audit spec, dsid_5f119369627543848ddc03d6805509dd](/knowledge/company/sources/confluence/security-and-compliance/audit-logging/audit-events-rollout-actions.json) | Marcus Lin / Kevin Osei |
+| Release choreography | Blocked | Change-management checklist remains in review with unchecked dogfood, beta-stability, staged-enable, communications, and backout controls. Initial launch must remain allowlisted (10–20 tenants), with one-hour observation after each batch and a freeze on routing anomalies. [Release checklist, dsid_fa0fb79e2f54457093ad3f831e7ac6a2](/knowledge/company/sources/google_drive/shared_drives/engineering/release-engineering/hosted-canary-ga-change-management-checklist.json) | Release engineering / Marissa Cole |
+| Support readiness | Conditional | Merged troubleshooting docs and resolved sample support ticket demonstrate usable material, but PM-1859 requires two recorded training sessions, validated macros, launch-week SLA, and active escalation ownership. [GA docs PR, dsid_3a0a0bdfb2ab4a93aecb7dd9b1773e9a](/knowledge/company/sources/github/redwood-docs/pr-922-console-hosted-canary-rollouts-ga-docs.json) [PM-1859, dsid_5444ca17e9664747930ead86571d4804](/knowledge/company/sources/linear/product-management/PM-1859-ga-launch-criteria-and-beta-exit-checklist-hosted-canary.json) | Dev Patel / Rafael Mendes |
+| Customer validation | Satisfied with conditions | Six partners used the workflow; four are GA-ready and two conditional. Remaining themes are threshold guidance, actionable policy messaging, audit completeness, and split-mismatch troubleshooting. [Tracker, dsid_22985fdc50d14444b0d278a5d93f5e08](/knowledge/company/sources/google_drive/shared_drives/product/console-and-rollouts/beta-design-partners-tracker-hosted-canary.json) | Simran Kaur / product |
+
+## Hard blockers and no-go triggers
+
+Broad GA is blocked by: (1) unsigned default thresholds; (2) no recorded successful GA staging game day; (3) incomplete release checklist; and (4) outstanding SRE, security, release, support, and final product approvals. Any open P0/P1 involving incorrect split enforcement, inability to rollback, or audit-trail gaps is an explicit no-go. Routing anomaly, rollback failure, cross-tenant audit/RBAC defect, or sustained alert storm during staged enablement requires freezing expansion and invoking the backout plan. [PM-1859, dsid_5444ca17e9664747930ead86571d4804](/knowledge/company/sources/linear/product-management/PM-1859-ga-launch-criteria-and-beta-exit-checklist-hosted-canary.json)
+
+## Remaining approvals
+
+- Final product call: Marissa Cole.
+- Platform/policy: Ethan Park / Jordan Lee.
+- Console engineering: Dylan Brooks / Chloe Martin.
+- Smart routing: Mina Haddad.
+- SRE: Sean Gallagher or Rafael Mendes.
+- Security/audit: Marcus Lin, with Kevin Osei on audit details.
+- Release readiness: release engineering after checklist and game-day evidence.
+- Docs/support: Elliot Price / Dev Patel.
+
+## Evidence-backed next steps
+

@@
-## Preliminary recommendation
+## Final recommendation
 
-**Conditional-go for a controlled allowlisted launch only.** Product definition, beta breadth, documentation implementation, and staged-enablement design support proceeding toward a limited cohort. Broad GA is not yet reviewable until operational, security, release, and support evidence is incorporated and their required approvals are explicit.
+**CONDITIONAL-GO for a controlled allowlisted launch only; NO-GO for broad GA.** Product definition, beta evidence, merged documentation, audit/RBAC foundations, staged enablement, and kill-switch design justify proceeding only after the pre-launch criteria below are accepted and evidenced. Broad GA remains blocked until all expansion criteria pass. No date is asserted.
+
+## Accepted launch criteria
+
+### Before the first allowlisted tenant
+
+- Final threshold table is filled and signed by product and SRE, including tier/region guidance, minimum samples/windows, soak time, and bursty/long-context handling.
+- GA staging game day passes split correctness, stop evaluation, alert actionability, audit attribution, kill switch, and global rollback-to-baseline enforcement in under two minutes.
+- No open P0/P1 exists for split correctness, rollback reliability, cross-tenant RBAC, or audit-trail completeness.
+- Security signs audit completeness, actor attribution, RBAC isolation, and retention/export posture.
+- Release engineering closes the applicable checklist entries and approves backout sequencing.
+- Two support trainings are recorded; macros, launch-week SLA, and escalation channel/on-call ownership are active.
+- Named product, platform, console, routing, SRE, security, release, docs, and support approvers record go.
+
+### During limited launch
+
+- Scope remains eligible hosted routes and 10–20 allowlisted tenants; existing routes are unchanged unless a rollout is created and started.
+- Observe dashboards for at least one hour after each enablement batch.
+- Freeze expansion on any routing-correctness anomaly; back out on rollback failure, cross-tenant access/audit defect, or sustained alert storm.
+- Preserve console-visible activity and operator audit history when the kill switch is used.
+
+### Before broad GA
+
+- Limited cohort meets the PM-1859 beta/GA exits with no unresolved qualifying incident or P0/P1.
+- Partner-conditional issues are resolved or explicitly documented and accepted: burst/long-context threshold guidance, actionable policy-denial copy, audit-event diff completeness, and split-mismatch troubleshooting.
+- Release notes and merged docs are published, not merely ready, and support evidence remains current.
@@
